msg: Be mindful that the points can change even for the same mushroom, but the points will probably stay similar for a few rounds. When the points become lower, try the other mushroom and see if the one that is higher has switched. Try and remember the points for each mushroom and whether the point amount for any feel like they stay consistent whether it's high or low, and choose the one that you feel is higher most of the time so you get more points altogether.
